meta.title: 跳槽前先问自己四个问题
meta.title_en: Four Questions to Ask Before a Job Hop

scenes.context: 讲者指出很多人跳槽是情绪冲动，而不是下一份工作更好。
sentences: 很多人跳槽，不是因为下一份工作有多好。
Most people job-hop not because the next job is better.
跳槽：job-hop
跟同事闹了矛盾，或者被领导批评了一顿。
You clash with a coworker, or get chewed out by your boss.
闹矛盾：clash with
一气之下就辞职了。
And quit in a fit of anger.
一气之下：in a fit of anger
paraphrase: 跳槽动机 → 常是情绪
The real trigger is often emotion.
Hasty decisions come with a high price.
scenes.speak: Most people job-hop not because the next job is better. You clash with a coworker, or get chewed out by your boss. And quit in a fit of anger.

scenes.context: 讲者给出跳槽前的四个自问，覆盖成长、能力、价值、现状。
sentences: 你在这份工作中真的没有成长空间了吗？
Is there really no room for you to grow in this role?
成长空间：room to grow
你的能力真的已经无法提升了吗？
Is your skill set really at its ceiling?
能力天花板：skill ceiling
你在这个岗位上真的已经无可替代了吗？
Are you really irreplaceable in this position?
无可替代：irreplaceable
paraphrase: 四个维度 → 校准自我判断
Four dimensions to calibrate your own judgment.
每个问题 → 都要用事实回答
Answer each with facts, not feelings.
scenes.speak: Is there really no room for you to grow in this role? Is your skill set really at its ceiling? Are you really irreplaceable in this position?

scenes.context: 讲者要求把四个问题认真过一遍再决定跳槽。
sentences: 把这四个问题在脑子里认认真真地过一遍。
Go through all four questions carefully in your head.
过一遍：go through
认认真真地想一想。
Actually take the time to think them through.
认真想一想：think them through
答完这四个问题之后，你再做跳槽的决定。
Only after you answer them should you make the call.
做决定：make the call
paraphrase: 答案不重要 → 思考过程重要
The answers matter less than the thinking itself.
先想清楚 → 再做决定
scenes.speak: Go through all four questions carefully in your head. Actually take the time to think them through. Only after you answer them should you make the call.

practice: I almost quit in a fit of anger over one argument.
There's still room for me to grow in this role.
Nobody is truly irreplaceable—check your assumptions.
Answer the four questions before you make the call.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：I want to change a job because of mood.
✓ 地道说法：I was tempted to quit in a fit of anger.
情绪冲动用 in a fit of anger。
✕ 直译腔：My ability can't be improved.
✓ 地道说法：My skill set has hit its ceiling.
能力到顶用 hit the ceiling。
✓ 地道说法：I assumed I was irreplaceable—but I checked the facts.
✓ 地道说法：Think these four questions through.
过一遍问题用 think through，不是 think problems。
shifts: 先识别情绪，再决定去留
用四问逐条用事实校准
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文个别口语（如「一气之下」「认认真真」）按口播习惯保留，无专有名词口误需校正。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
